items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jerry Preston's. It was an after-hour place... Jerry Preston's After Hour Spot.

ctx.x: Jerry Preston's. It was an after-hour place. After hour spot there on 132nd between 7th and Lenox. Jerry Preston's After Hour Spot. Then of course there at the Rhythm Club, those jam sessions was just something. They could start off with nothing, maybe piano, drums and trumpet. Before the night's over, or the day, whatever they get together, it would be 10, 11 pieces there jamming. And not only on one tune. They would play one tune and then segue into another tune, and go from one key right on through the whole…
That's interesting, because what sessions there are now....
